rows.label: Points/Game
rows.description: Average points scored per game.

rows.label: Points Allowed/Game
rows.description: Average points allowed per game.

rows.label: Scoring Margin
rows.description: Points scored minus points allowed, per game.

rows.label: Yards/Play (Off)
rows.description: Offensive yards per scrimmage play.

rows.label: Yards/Play (Def)
rows.description: Yards allowed per opponent scrimmage play.

rows.label: Net EPA/Play
rows.description: Offensive EPA per play minus the EPA per play the defence allows. The single best play-by-play summary of how much better a team is than its opponents: it credits a dominant defence as much as a prolific offence and cannot be inflated by pace.

rows.label: Net Yards/Play
rows.description: Offensive yards per play minus defensive yards per play allowed.

rows.label: Rush Yds/Game
rows.description: Rushing yards per game.

rows.label: Opp Rush Yds/Game
rows.description: Rushing yards allowed per game.

rows.label: Yards/Rush
rows.description: Rushing yards per rushing attempt.

rows.label: Opp Yards/Rush
rows.description: Rushing yards allowed per opponent attempt.

rows.label: Pass Yds/Game
rows.description: Net passing yards per game.

rows.label: Opp Pass Yds/Game
rows.description: Net passing yards allowed per game.

rows.label: Yards/Pass Att
rows.description: Net passing yards per pass attempt.

rows.label: Opp Yards/Pass Att
rows.description: Net passing yards allowed per opponent attempt.

rows.label: Completion %
rows.description: Completions divided by attempts.

rows.label: Sack Rate Allowed
rows.description: Sacks taken per dropback.

rows.label: Sack Rate
rows.description: Sacks generated per opponent dropback.

rows.label: Pressure Rate Allowed
rows.description: Opponent pressures per dropback (PFR).

rows.label: Pressure Rate
rows.description: Individual defender pressures per opponent dropback (PFR); can exceed play-level rate.

rows.label: Havoc Allowed
rows.description: Share of offensive plays with a TFL, sack, forced fumble, interception or pass breakup against.

rows.label: Havoc Rate
rows.description: Share of defensive plays producing a TFL, sack, forced fumble, interception or pass breakup.

rows.label: Front-Seven Havoc
rows.description: Havoc plays generated by the front seven, per defensive play.

rows.label: Secondary Havoc
rows.description: Havoc plays generated by defensive backs, per defensive play.

rows.label: Line Yards
rows.description: Rushing yards credited to the offensive line per rush (Football Outsiders formula).

rows.label: Line Yards Allowed
rows.description: Line yards allowed per opponent rush.

rows.label: Opportunity Rate
rows.description: Share of rushes gaining at least 4 yards.

rows.label: Stuff Rate Allowed
rows.description: Share of rushes stopped at or behind the line.

rows.label: Stuff Rate
rows.description: Share of opponent rushes stopped at or behind the line.

rows.label: Power Success
rows.description: Conversion rate on 3rd/4th down rushes needing 2 yards or fewer.

rows.label: 3rd Down % (Off)
rows.description: Third-down conversion rate.

rows.label: 3rd Down % (Def)
rows.description: Third-down conversion rate allowed.

rows.label: 4th Down % (Off)
rows.description: Fourth-down conversion rate.

rows.label: Red Zone TD % (Off)
rows.description: Touchdowns per red-zone trip.

rows.label: Red Zone TD % (Def)
rows.description: Touchdowns allowed per opponent red-zone trip.

rows.label: Turnover Margin
rows.description: Takeaways minus giveaways, per game.

rows.label: Giveaways/Game
rows.description: Turnovers committed per game.

rows.label: Takeaways/Game
rows.description: Turnovers forced per game.

rows.label: INT Rate
rows.description: Interceptions thrown per pass attempt.

rows.label: Fumble Rate
rows.description: Fumbles lost per offensive play.

rows.label: Offensive EPA/Play
rows.description: Expected points added per play (CFB: CFBD PPA; NFL: nflfastR EPA).

rows.label: Offensive Passing EPA/Play
rows.description: EPA per pass play.

rows.label: Offensive Rushing EPA/Play
rows.description: Expected points added per rushing play.

rows.label: Offensive Early-Down EPA
rows.description: EPA per play on 1st and 2nd down.

rows.label: Offensive Late-Down EPA
rows.description: EPA per play on 3rd and 4th down.

rows.label: Offensive Success Rate
rows.description: Share of plays meeting the success yardage threshold (NFL: EPA>0).

rows.label: Offensive Passing Success
rows.description: Success rate on pass plays.

rows.label: Offensive Rushing Success
rows.description: Success rate on rushes.

rows.label: Offensive Standard-Down Success
rows.description: Success rate on standard downs.

rows.label: Offensive Passing-Down Success
rows.description: Success rate on passing downs.

rows.label: Offensive Explosiveness
rows.description: Average EPA on successful plays (IsoPPP-style).

rows.label: Defensive EPA/Play
rows.description: Expected points added per play allowed (CFB: CFBD PPA; NFL: nflfastR EPA).

rows.label: Defensive Passing EPA/Play
rows.description: EPA per pass play allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Rushing EPA/Play
rows.description: Expected points added per rushing play allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Early-Down EPA
rows.description: EPA per play on 1st and 2nd down allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Late-Down EPA
rows.description: EPA per play on 3rd and 4th down allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Success Rate
rows.description: Share of plays allowed meeting the success yardage threshold (NFL: EPA>0).

rows.label: Defensive Passing Success
rows.description: Success rate on pass plays allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Rushing Success
rows.description: Success rate on rushes allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Standard-Down Success
rows.description: Success rate on standard downs allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Passing-Down Success
rows.description: Success rate on passing downs allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Explosiveness
rows.description: Average EPA on successful plays allowed (IsoPPP-style).

rows.label: Explosive Play Rate
rows.description: Share of plays gaining 10+ rushing or 20+ passing yards.

rows.label: Explosive Plays Allowed
rows.description: Share of opponent plays gaining 10+ rushing or 20+ passing yards.

rows.label: 10+ Yard Rush Rate
rows.description: Share of rushes gaining 10+ yards.

rows.label: 20+ Yard Pass Rate
rows.description: Share of dropbacks producing a 20+ yard completion.

rows.label: Points/Scoring Opportunity
rows.description: Points per drive that reached the opponent 40.

rows.label: Points Allowed/Scoring Opp
rows.description: Points allowed per opponent drive reaching your 40.

rows.label: TD Rate in Opp Territory
rows.description: Touchdowns per drive that reached the opponent 40.

rows.label: Avg Starting Field Position
rows.description: Average own-yardline where offensive drives start.

rows.label: Opp Avg Starting Field Position
rows.description: Average own-yardline where opponent drives start.

rows.label: Plays/Game
rows.description: Offensive scrimmage plays per game.

rows.label: Seconds/Play
rows.description: Average seconds between offensive snaps within a drive (lower = faster pace).

rows.label: Neutral-Script Seconds/Play
rows.description: Seconds per play when the score is within 8 in the first three quarters (lower = faster pace).

rows.label: Pass Rate
rows.description: Dropbacks per scrimmage play.

rows.label: Early-Down Pass Rate
rows.description: Dropbacks per play on 1st and 2nd down.

rows.label: Neutral-Script Pass Rate
rows.description: Dropbacks per play when the game is within 8 points in the first three quarters.

rows.label: Special Teams EPA/Play
rows.description: Expected points added per kicking-game play this team executes (punts, kickoffs, field goals, extra points).

rows.label: Opp Special Teams EPA/Play
rows.description: Expected points added per kicking-game play the opponent executes against this team.

rows.label: Punt EPA/Play
rows.description: Expected points added per punt, capturing distance, hang time and coverage together.

rows.label: Kickoff EPA/Play
rows.description: Expected points added per kickoff, capturing touchback rate and coverage.

rows.label: Field Goal EPA/Attempt
rows.description: Expected points added per field-goal attempt relative to the expectation from that distance.

rows.label: Avg FG Distance
rows.description: Average field-goal attempt distance in yards.

rows.label: Play-Action Rate
rows.description: Play-action dropbacks per dropback (FTN).

rows.label: RPO Rate
rows.description: RPO plays per scrimmage play (FTN).

rows.label: Shotgun Rate
rows.description: Snaps from shotgun per scrimmage play.

rows.label: Avg Air Yards
rows.description: Average depth of target on pass attempts.

rows.label: Deep Pass Rate
rows.description: Share of attempts thrown 20+ yards downfield.

rows.label: Blitz Rate
rows.description: Share of opponent dropbacks with 5+ pass rushers (FTN).

rows.label: Pressure Without Blitz
rows.description: QB hits or sacks per opponent dropback with 4 or fewer rushers (proxy).

inputs.basis: draft capital on the current roster

market.public_note: Ticket and money percentages are unavailable (no free structured feed); reverse-line-movement is therefore not evaluated.
notes: The spread has held at home +1.5 since our first snapshot (draftkings).
The model's margin differs from the market by 1.1 points, leaning to the away team.
On the total the model is 3.6 points over the market number.
Based on 111 snapshots across 8 books. Public ticket/money percentages are unavailable, so reverse line movement is not claimed.

sources.note: Opponent-adjusted values are this platform's own ridge fits; early-season values blend the previous season's adjusted numbers.
